race.comment: INDEFINITE (2) needs to rebound from his Townsville run, but can do in easier company. His close Cairns fourth in a CL4 giving him a genuine path back into the race. REGAL JUDGEMENT (4) is hard to trust off a poor run at Charleville, but his previous win over DARK HARMONY at this venue and his overall record at this track and distance keep him firmly in calculations. DARK HARMONY (3) shoulders a reliable profile at this track and distance. He was beaten 2.5L by REGAL JUDGEMENT here last start as the well-supported favourite, yet his broader record reads well for this. Sure to be very competitive. ZEPHIRINE (1) brings winning form after scoring in Open company at this track over 1200m, and her 1450m record is strong enough to keep her in the major mix.
